title: When ego keeps making the self too large as a steady practice
issueStatement: The self keeps pushing itself to the center of the room. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru names haumai clearly and then redirects the heart toward humility, service, and truth. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: The cure begins when ego is seen as illness rather than identity. Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it.
actionPrompt: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. Repeat what you can actually keep.
